official.application_cycle: 2026 round; awards tenable from early 2026 and may be held in any USP member country
official.status_note: The official PSERI page is marked CLOSED; the 2026 round closed at midnight Monday 5 January 2026 and awards from that round are tenable from early 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: A PSERI award in 2026 comprises: 'Tuition fees (paid directly)', with 'General Services fees paid directly' and 'Health Services fees paid directly' also listed among the award components.
benefits: Tuition fees (paid directly); General Services fees paid directly; Health Services fees paid directly
Living allowance of $21,600 for Masters students and $24,000 for PhD students per year to be paid on a monthly basis
Dependents Allowance of $10,883.00 per year and Establishment Allowance of $1,942.00 (one-off) to qualifying awardees
Research grant - only after the research plan and budget have been approved by the appropriate Academic Unit Research Committee (AURC)
One return airfare when the person receiving the award has to travel to a USP campus in another country to take up the offer; all amounts are in Fijian dollars
eligibility: Applicants must be citizens of a USP member country
Preferably be 35 years or younger for Masters studies and 45 years or younger for PhD studies at the time of application
Master's applicants must have a grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.5 at the undergraduate level
Master's applicants must have a GPA of 3.5 or above in both undergraduate and postgraduate levels; a Postgraduate Diploma GPA of at least 3.5 is given preference
PhD applicants are required to have completed a Master's degree by thesis
Applicants for a Masters degree should normally have completed a Postgraduate Diploma (or equivalent)
requirements: Scholarships are for full-time study only
Awardees are not permitted to be in paid employment during the tenure of their awards
Awardees will work a minimum of 40 hours per week for the entire year on their research
Scholarship holders are expected to contribute to ongoing teaching in their respective faculties for a maximum of eight hours per week only during semester time
Final year undergraduate students must explicitly state the expected date of completion of their current programme in the application letter
documents: Completed Applicant Detail Form and Applicant Checklist (linked from the PSERI page)
Cover letter or a letter of application
An outline of a proposed research topic, on the Research Intent Template
Name and contact details of three referees
Certified true copies of relevant transcripts and certificates, plus proof of citizenship
selection_criteria: GPA of at least 3.5 at undergraduate level for Master's applicants, with GPA of 3.5 or above required at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels to be considered
Preference for Master's applicants who also hold a Postgraduate Diploma with GPA of at least 3.5
Preference for applicants 35 years or younger (Masters) or 45 years or younger (PhD) at the time of application
Funding priority for interdisciplinary projects falling within USP's Strategic Research Themes, underpinned by Innovation, Empowerment & Sustainability
coverage: Tuition, General Services and Health Services fees paid directly by USP
Book allowance of up to FJD 750 per year
Living allowance of FJD 21,600 (Masters) or FJD 24,000 (PhD) per year, paid monthly

Dependents Allowance of FJD 10,883.00 per year for qualifying awardees only - dependent spouse must be unemployed and dependent children under 18 must reside with the awardee and be mainly supported by them
One-off Establishment Allowance of FJD 1,942.00 for awardees relocating to a USP campus (expected award of at least 12 months; home outside the greater Suva area; no other relocation package)
One return airfare when the awardee must travel to a USP campus in another country; research costs are covered only through the research grant after AURC approval of the research plan and budget
application_method: Completed applications must be sent via email to pgrscholarships@usp.ac.fj with the subject line 'PSERI 2026 Application - [Your Name]'
All eight required documents must be included in the same emailed application
Queries can be emailed to pgrscholarships@usp.ac.fj or to the Research Student Coordinator (Letila Talemaitoga, letila.talemaitoga@usp.ac.fj, phone 3231888)
official.application_route: Email a complete application package to pgrscholarships@usp.ac.fj using the exact subject line 'PSERI <year> Application - [Your Name]'; no online portal is offered
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be citizens of a USP member country
official.international_eligibility: Open to citizens of any USP member country (not restricted to Fiji); awards may be held in any USP member country
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Research must align with USP's Strategic Research Themes (Sustainable, Inclusive and Equitable Economies; Oceans, Ecosystems & Climate Resilience; Education, Culture, Health & Wellbeing; Governance, Justice and Equality; Innovation, Empowerment and Sustainability) and be hosted by one of USP's academic units: SAFE, SAGEONS, SBM, STEMP, SoLaSS, SPACE or the Centre for Sustainable Futures
official.research_requirement: Degree must be by research only (Master's or PhD); applicants submit an outline of a proposed research topic at application and may discuss the application with a potential supervisor; the research grant is released only after the research plan and budget are approved by the appropriate Academic Unit Research Committee
official.duration: Masters: 18 months for applicants who have completed a Postgraduate Diploma, 24 months for applicants with an Undergraduate Degree only; PhD: 36 months
official.description: The University of the South Pacific invites applications for the Pacific Scholarship for Excellence in Research & Innovation (PSERI) to undertake a Master's degree or PhD by research only at USP, with awards tenable from early 2026 and tenable in any USP member country. The University states it is keen to fund interdisciplinary projects that fall within its Strategic Research Themes, which are all underpinned by Innovation, Empowerment & Sustainability.
official.region: Oceania / Pacific (awards tenable in any USP member country)
official.program_type: University postgraduate research scholarship (Master's or PhD by research)

applicant_utility.summary: PSERI funds full-time research-only Master's or PhD degrees at any USP member country, paying tuition and the general and health services fees directly while adding a monthly living allowance of FJD 21,600 (Master's) or FJD 24,000 (PhD) per year. The 2026 round closed on 5 January 2026, so the immediate move is to watch USP's postgraduate scholarships page for the next year-dated call and pre-build the eight-document email package. Winning still requires a separate place: awardees must enrol in one of USP's academic units, and the scholarship does not guarantee that enrolment.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Citizens of a USP member country aged 35 or under (Master's) or 45 or under (PhD) with a GPA of at least 3.5 and a Pacific-relevant research idea that fits one of USP's Strategic Research Themes.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the current year's Applicant Detail Form, Applicant Checklist and Research Intent Template from the PSERI page rather than reusing an older year's file
Secure certified true copies of all transcripts and certificates, plus a proof of citizenship document, before the call opens
Line up three referees and confirm their current contact details are in the CV
Draft the research topic outline around one of USP's five Strategic Research Themes and one of the six academic units
If in the final year of an undergraduate degree, state the expected completion date explicitly in the cover letter
common_rejection_risks: Undergraduate GPA below 3.5, or a Master's applicant without a 3.5 GPA at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels
Applying for a PhD without a completed Master's degree by thesis
Research topic that does not fit any academic unit's supported areas for the current round, leaving no available supervisor or host
A late or mis-addressed submission - the page sets a hard midnight closing date and email is the only route
Missing or uncertified transcripts, an unsigned checklist, or fewer than three referees
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published benefit list does not cover dependants' travel, visa or immigration costs, or research expenditure incurred before the Academic Unit Research Committee approves the research plan and budget; relocation costs beyond the FJD 1,942 establishment allowance are also on the awardee.
document_audit: Transcripts and certificates must be certified true copies, not plain photocopies
Proof of citizenship is a separate required document and doubles as the member-country eligibility test
Exactly three referees with contact details must be named - unnamed or unreachable referees stall the file
The whole package travels in one email; USP asks for the checklist alongside the detail form, so incomplete checklists are an easy self-inflicted rejection
The research outline must be on the Research Intent Template linked from the PSERI page, not a free-form essay
alerts: The page is CLOSED: the published deadline of midnight Monday 5 January 2026 belongs to the 2026 round, and no next-round date has been posted, so plan for an early-January-style closing in the next call without assuming a date
The scholarship does not guarantee a place in an academic unit - contact a potential supervisor early but treat enrolment as a separate hurdle
Awardees cannot take paid employment for the whole tenure and must commit a minimum of 40 hours per week to research, plus up to eight hours a week of teaching in semester time
Living allowance is FJD-denominated; budget for Pacific cost-of-living differences between campuses in different member countries
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Send one email to pgrscholarships@usp.ac.fj carrying all eight documents under the exact subject line 'PSERI <year> Application - [Your Name]' before the midnight deadline, then await Research Office queries, secure a place and supervisor in an academic unit, and lodge the research plan with the Academic Unit Research Committee to unlock the research grant
